notes: fossil_by_year["2022"] counts from 24 Feb 2022 (CREA counter default start); 2022_calendar_full also given. 2023-2025 are calendar years; 2026_ytd is 1 Jan-16 Oct 2026 (latest days may be revised upward as Kpler arrivals are confirmed).

CREA values = estimated payments to Russian exporters (export value at CREA modelled prices), certainty B. fossil_2021 also from CREA (same method) for comparability; UN Comtrade importer-reported 2021 values given as cross-check (A).

CREA attributes by destination (first discharge/border). Pipeline gas entering via Nord Stream/TurkStream/Ukraine transit is attributed to the entry/offtake country as modelled by CREA; values for transit hubs (DE, SK, AT, TR, HU) may include gas consumed elsewhere.
CREA does not track rail/road deliveries or most pipeline flows to CIS countries (Belarus absent; KZ, KG, AM, UZ, AZ partial) -> null or lower bound.

laundered_oil is heterogenous: for USA/GBR/AUS it is product value refined from Russian crude; for NLD/FRA/ITA it is the value of Russian crude input (Dec 2022-Dec 2023 only). All are partial-period lower bounds; see laundered_oil_detail.windows. Gross figures (all products from refineries that use Russian crude) are NOT counted in the headline value.
oil_discount_gain only for IND, CHN, TUR (published third-party estimates, different methods/periods); other countries null.
EUR conversion of USD figures uses ECB annual average for the year of the flow (multi-year Australia figure uses mean 2023-2025).

2026 YTD values are high relative to 2025 for some buyers (e.g. China EUR 67.0 bn by 16 Oct vs 65.8 bn in all of 2025) because oil prices spiked in 2026 (CREA Hormuz-crisis analysis, https://energyandcleanair.org/what-the-hormuz-crisis-has-cost-fossil-fuel-importers-march-to-august-2026/; Brent ~USD 126-130/bbl mid-Oct 2026 per FRED DCOILBRENTEU).

Sanity check: CREA EU 2021 total EUR 137.8 bn is higher than importer-reported customs data (Comtrade sum) mainly because EU customs do not attribute much pipeline gas to Russian origin and CREA prices gas at hub prices.
